games.title: Bugs & Drugs Tower Defense
games.subtitle: BDTD for short
games.pitch: Tower defence through the body: pick the right drug for every bug, from the lungs to the CD4 ward.
games.detail: 11 organ levels plus an endless mode, 163 organisms and 157 drugs, every line cited to First Aid by page.

games.title: Tidal
games.subtitle: Shape the lung curve
games.pitch: Shape the lung curve. Name the disease. Drag flow-volume loops, spirograms and O₂–Hb curves into the shape that fits the case.
games.detail: 29 pathologies, a daily run you can share, and a practice mode with a match meter.

games.title: Rounds
games.subtitle: One patient a day
games.pitch: One patient a day, the same case for everyone. Ask anything, order labs or imaging, or call your resident, attending or a grumpy surgeon for help, then name the diagnosis. Every move costs points, so work fast and lean.
games.detail: A new case every day plus 19 cardiology and pulmonology cases to practise on, built on First Aid, Pathoma and current guidelines. Share your score and time like a Wordle.
